## GRENADA — profile (page 164)
- Header facts: Region: Latin America & the Caribbean; income group: Upper-middle-income; lending category: Blend; data status: Data as reported (A); population: 117 thousand; GNI: 1,341.8; unit line: US$ million, unless otherwise indicated.
- Total external debt stock, 2025: 905.8, with +4.9% from 2024.

- Figure 1. Total external debt, 2015–25: 602.3 (2015) to 905.8 (2025). The line is roughly flat to slightly down in the early years (≈2015–18), then jumps sharply around 2019, rises to a peak at 2025, with minor fluctuations/plateauing at high levels in the intervening years (≈2020–24).

- Figure 2. External debt by creditor and creditor type in 2025, including IMF credit and SDR allocations:
  - Total external debt: 905.8
  - Public & publicly guaranteed (PPG): 882.4
  - Short-term: 23.5
  - PPG by creditor type:
    - Multilateral: 493.7
    - Bilateral: 258.3
    - Private creditors: 130.4
  - Multilateral breakdown:
    - World Bank-IDA: 273.4
    - Caribbean Dev. Bank: 133.5
    - Other multilateral: 86.8
  - Bilateral breakdown:
    - Venezuela, RB: 137.8
    - China: 65.9
    - Other bilateral: 54.5

- Figure 3. Debt ratios, 2015–25:
  - External debt / exports: 105%, +4.4%; trend is low and fairly stable early on, dips slightly, spikes around the middle of the period, then declines and edges up again by 2025.
  - External debt / GNI: 68%, -0.5%; trend declines early, jumps sharply mid-period, then eases gradually and is broadly flat by 2025.
  - Debt service / exports: 6%, +9.2%; trend rises from low levels, fluctuates, then declines toward 2025 with a slight uptick at the end.
  - Debt service / GNI: 4%, +4.0%; trend rises early, stays elevated with fluctuations, then falls and ends with a small rebound in 2025.

- Figure 4. Average terms on new commitments from official and private creditors, 2025:
  - Official creditors: maturity 37 yrs; grace period 9 yrs; interest rate 0.8%
  - Private creditors: maturity ..; grace period ..; interest rate ..

- Notes/Source:
  - Source: World Bank Group International Debt Statistics database.
  - Note: Figure 4 shows no data values for private creditors because the country did not have new commitments in 2025.
